data.current_description:
Returns 202 with a `request_id`. The job runs asynchronously
(10s–5min depending on mode). Two ways to retrieve the result:

- **Polling** — `GET /v1/queries/{id}` every 5–10 seconds until
  `status == "completed"`. Recommended cadence: 5s for the
  first 60s, then 10s.
- **SSE** — `GET /v1/queries/{id}/stream` to receive
  `progress` events plus a final `result`.

### Idempotency

Pass an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string ≤ 200 chars)
to make submission idempotent. Replays within 24h with the same
body return the original `request_id` with
`idempotent_replayed: true`. Replays with a different body
return 409 `idempotency_conflict`.

### Restart caveat (V1)

In V1, in-flight jobs live in process memory. If the worker
restarts mid-run, polling returns 404. Retry with the same
`Idempotency-Key` — the next submit will re-enqueue without
double-charging credits. We're migrating to durable queues
post-V1; until then, set client retry policy on 404.
data.description_suggestion: Submits a verification query for multi-model synthesis across GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok. Returns 202 with a `request_id` and runs asynchronously (10s–5min depending on mode). Deducts credits from account balance based on selected mode and models. Retrieve results via polling (`GET /v1/queries/{id}`) or Server-Sent Events (`GET /v1/queries/{id}/stream`). Supports idempotent submission via `Idempotency-Key` header (replays within 24h return original `request_id` with `idempotent_replayed: true`). Note: V1 jobs live in process memory; worker restarts may cause 404 on polling—retry with same `Idempotency-Key` to re-enqueue without double-charging.

data.current_summary: Get the result of a submitted query
data.current_description:
Returns one of:

- **200** with `status: "queued"` or `status: "running"` while
  the job is in flight. Repeat until `status == "completed"`.
- **200** with `status: "completed"` and the full response body
  once the job finishes.
- **200** with `status: "failed"` and an `error` block if the
  aggregation pipeline raised. Don't retry on this — the
  underlying problem won't fix itself.
- **404** if the `request_id` isn't found (expired or worker
  restart — see Idempotency on POST).
data.description_suggestion: Polls the status and result of a submitted verification query. Returns 200 with one of four states: (1) `status: "queued"` or `status: "running"` while processing—repeat polling until completion; (2) `status: "completed"` with the full synthesized response including provider outputs, conflicts, and confidence scores; (3) `status: "failed"` with an error block if aggregation failed—do not retry as the underlying issue won't self-resolve; (4) 404 if the request_id expired or was lost due to worker restart—retry submission with the same `Idempotency-Key` to re-enqueue. Recommended polling cadence: 5s for first 60s, then 10s.

data.current_summary: List available models grouped by provider
data.current_description:
Returns the catalog of models the API can select from. Group
keys are public provider names (`openai`, `anthropic`, `google`,
`xai`); each group is an ordered array of models.

Each model lists its `model_id` (the value to pass in the
`models` field on `POST /v1/queries`), pricing per million
tokens, and a `tier` hint (`budget`, `standard`, `premium`).

Use this endpoint to discover available model options before submitting queries or to understand pricing differences across tiers.
